title: Browse and Edit Project Files
trigger: User needs to navigate and modify code or text files

steps.action: Open File Explorer from the + in the switcher bar or from the Apps menu
Click or single-click a file in the tree to browse; it opens in a preview tab in File Viewer
Double-click or start typing to promote the preview tab and keep the file open
Edit the file using keyboard and mouse; syntax highlighting and line numbers appear automatically
Press Ctrl+S to save; unsaved files show a dot on their tab
Middle-click a tab or click the X to close it; unsaved work prompts to save, discard, or cancel

outcome: Files are opened in tabs with syntax highlighting, and changes can be saved
